paragraphs.text: Here is figured Christ to whom all his should give willing obedience, and who would show himself terrible to the wicked.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He has made the Jews who were the keepers of the law and prophets, schoolmasters to the Gentiles, that they would with gladness obey them.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: God has chosen us above all other nations, to enjoy a most glorious inheritance.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He alludes to the trumpets that were blown at solemn feasts: but he further signifies the triumph of Christ and his glorious ascension into the heavens.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He requires that understanding be joined with singing, lest the Name of God be profaned with vain crying.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: He praises God's highness, for that he joins the great princes of the world (whom he calls shields) to the fellowship of his Church.
paragraphs.label: f
